rappel_detail.anchor: natural: a sling around a horn or block; no fixed hardware documented
rappel_detail.station: Above the short exposed step low on the southwest ridge.
rappel_detail.notes: Optional single-rope rappel for parties not comfortable reversing the step; most competent scrambling parties downclimb it.
hazards: Stay well back from the southeast face edge, which drops 4,800 ft to Enchanted Valley.

set.rappels: 1 optional short single-rope rappel off a natural anchor over the exposed step low on the ridge; otherwise downclimbed
